item.title: New affordable housing complex opens in Rancho Bernardo
item.description: A new affordable housing complex has opened in Rancho Bernardo, offering 100 luxury-style units.

item.title: Increase in Jeep thefts throughout San Diego County
item.description: Jeep Wranglers are one of the most sought-after cars for buyers, but also for thieves, who target them for their parts and off-road capabilities, and a simple steering wheel lock can help prevent theft.

item.title: Dozens of San Diego County schools earn California Purple Star designation
item.description: The California Department of Education has recognized 43 schools in San Diego County with the California Purple Star School designation for their efforts to support military-connected students and their families.

item.title: Father Joe’s Villages highlights pet-inclusive shelter program in San Diego
item.description: Father Joe's Villages in San Diego has partnered with My Dog Is My Home to provide a program that allows people experiencing homelessness to stay with their pets, removing a barrier that often prevents people from seeking help.

item.title: Humane Society rescues 34 cats and kittens from the city of Stockton
item.description: The San Diego Humane Society rescued 34 cats and kittens from the Stockton animal shelter to help ease overcrowding and provide medical care before they are adopted.

item.title: San Diego Mojo sets record with best seven-match streak ever
item.description: San Diego Mojo achieves a remarkable seven-match stretch, rising to third place in the Major League Volleyball Standings.

item.title: Security cameras and license plate reader technology used to find stabbing suspect
item.description: The San Diego County Sheriff's Office used registered street cameras and Flock license plate-reading technology to locate the suspect in a December stabbing, leading to the arrest of the suspect on Feb. 17.

item.title: Traffic backed up on I-8 and I-805 due to stalled semi
item.description: A stalled semi-truck on the I-8 west at the I-805 south connect caused traffic to back up on both freeways, with vehicles traveling around 10-20 mph in the area.

item.title: Bishop arrested at airport, accused of embezzling church money
item.description: Bishop Emanuel Shaleta, 69, of the diocese of St. Peter the Apostle, was arrested on suspicion of embezzling hundreds of thousands of dollars from his own church, after being seen going into a Tijuana brothel and being investigated by the Vatican and the Sheriff's department.
